method: All checkpoint dispositions/presence checked. Active V1 critical paths plus unchanged auth/session/CSRF/storage/error paths reviewed; generated metadata tied to native DB evidence and immutable applied hashes. Regression/live checks provide behavioral evidence; this is not formal security or semantic verification.
